title: ModernCraft city server
body:
- JOIN THE DISCORD FOR UP TO DATE INFO (IP may change): https://discord.com/invite/KXMJc9nGCX
- WE USE OUR OWN CUSTOM TEXTURE! You may get it on join or [on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mcs-v7)
- LATEST DYNMAP URL: [http://67.216.85.77:25605/](http://67.216.85.77:25605/). - NOTE WE RUN A FAST DAILY RESTART AT 13 GMT

# What do we do?

Creating Minecraft cities and architecture since 2022. Cross-play for full Java 1.21.1+ & Bedrock compatibility.

We're passionate about REALISM: Architecture of many styles, mansions, interiors, vehicles, infrastructure etc.

Our texture pack is geared towards that, with toned down colors, high definition, city-related block models etc.

# What do we provide?

The server is here for you 24/7 with map protection & backups. We're not always active; you can change that!

We use a rank system to preserve trust and prevent grief! Rankup in the discord #rankup-portfolios channel!

We have command shortcuts (Builders Utilities), nv, nc, heads, homes, etc, and a discord #feedback channel!

Visitor -> Potential -> Builder -> Builder+ -> Architect

- Visitors: plot101, full World Edit/FAWE, full VoxelSniper/FAVS, basic Arceon. Axiom may be unsupported!
- Potential: More plots + flatworld1
- Builders: More plots + flatworld2
- Builder+: More plots + ACCESS TO MOSLYN & KALAK MAIN CITY PROJECTS
- Architect: Max plots + access showcase/archived worlds & extra commands

# Main city projects?

Our flagship community-built cities! High quality repeat contributors get paid commissions or a % cut.*
*Since we put substantial time/money into the server, finished core projects may be sold to offset costs.

[MCS Moslyn Island - 2K Coastal cities w/ interior V6 (Est. 22)](https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/moderncraft-moslyn-city-progress-renders-v1/)
